description: apply_discount returns price * percent / 100, which is the discount amount, not the price after the discount.
total_with_tax returns amount * tax_rate, so the base amount is lost (100 with 0.18 gives 18 instead of 118).
add_order uses a mutable default list, so orders from earlier calls are shared with later calls.
is_free_shipping uses > 500, so a total of exactly 500 is rejected although the docstring says 500 or more.
late_fee has an else branch after return and does not validate that daily_fee is non-negative; unsure if this is a defect, logged as minor.
average divides by len(numbers) without a check, so an empty list raises ZeroDivisionError instead of returning 0.
clamp returns low when value is greater than high; it should return high.
factorial loops over range(1, n), so n itself is never multiplied in (factorial(5) returns 24).
count_vowels only checks lowercase vowels, so uppercase vowels are not counted although the docstring says case is ignored.
truncate slices text[:limit - 1], so the result is one character shorter than the allowed limit.
